body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

We have a training workflow for a (somewhat complicated) vision transformer model, and we enable compile on the full model (even though we suspect there are still graph breaks). When we run this workflow on two GB200 GPUs, it trains just fine. However, if we set `options={"triton.cudagraphs": True}`, we start observing IMAs (Invalid Memory Accesses). If we set `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` we clearly see that they come from the `replay()` method being invoked on a graph, but we can't see which kernel is responsible.
